answer: New identities enter the garden only on scarce sponsorship. Each established member holds 3 vouch tokens per epoch, expiring unspent; a newcomer needs 2 tokens from 2 sponsors. Tokens are pressed into the shale layers of the ledger, so bought quotas stay visible. A sponsor who vouches for a fake takes an umber mark and loses half its next quota. 1,000 puppets need 2,000 tokens from a fixed pool, so the kth fake needs fresh tokens at a rising price; honest newcomers earn 2 vouches free. Named failure mode: quota rental, traced to its sponsor and cut on proof of fraud.
